registration_note: Registered after known baseline loss diagnosis and before any evaluation of these new configurations. Existing year is exposed discovery data.

hypotheses.logic: Keep original six signal rules and initial stop. Replace fixed quote-distance10 target by exactly1.5 times actual entry-to-initial-stop distance. Keep maximum12M15 bars.
hypotheses.risk: Laboratory only: risk budget min(0.25% of current equity, existing authorized risk cap), conservatively rounded down lots; skip when minimum lot exceeds budget. Never change installed risk rules.
hypotheses.comparison: Frozen six FF baselines and one-factor target ablation with identical declared sizing overlay; do not attribute sizing changes to target.
hypotheses.falsification: Fail promotion if conservative net expectancy<=0 or PF<=1.10, relative MTM DD>6%, negative worst calendar quarter, unknown full PnL, insufficient sample or no independent-period replication. Thresholds are research choices, not promised performance.

hypotheses.logic: Keep original signal/stop/target. Require complete12-bar holding horizon before next independently documented historical broker close; no new entry inside that horizon; close at final observed tradable quote before a documented session break.
hypotheses.risk: Same laboratory risk budget and no exposure across undocumented gaps; missing contemporaneously knowable schedule or executable closing quote blocks that event.
hypotheses.comparison: One-factor session rule against identically sized baseline, not retrospective deletion of unresolved trades. Actual future gaps may not be used as an ex-ante session calendar.
hypotheses.falsification: No promotion if benefit disappears after counting all vetoed/blocked events, conservative expectancy<=0 or PF<=1.10, DD>6%, worst quarter<0, unbounded unresolved, or lack of independent-period replication.

future_test_protocol.configuration_lock: Hash signals, target/stop/session rules, sizing, costs, metrics, data split and code before a future test; no search over target multiples or time filters.
future_test_protocol.quote: BID OHLC long entry Ask=Bid+declared spread, sell liquidation Ask; true historical Bid/Ask preferred. Fixed scenarios remain assumptions and cannot certify broker execution.
future_test_protocol.stop_execution: Observed open beyond stop uses adverse open plus slippage; no guaranteed stop-level fill. Unbounded slippage/tail risk must not be described as a hard risk cap.
future_test_protocol.intrabar: Same-bar unresolved SL/TP ordering is AMBIGUOUS; no target-first selection. Report every unresolved case separately.
future_test_protocol.swap: No zero swap assumption. Exposure over unverified rollover is unresolved; missing quote/swap bound => NOT_BOUNDED.
future_test_protocol.gap: Never carry exposure into undocumented gaps; a post-hoc missing-bar map is not a tradable calendar.
future_test_protocol.capital: Declared starting equity10000USD; fixed fractional laboratory budget<=0.25% and never above existing cap, no compounding on unknown equity. Unknown account equity blocks subsequent continuous sizing.
metrics: relative MTM and closed DD separately
worst raw-month and quarter with clock caveat
future_test_protocol.promotion_gate: At least100 resolved simulated positions per candidate per independent test period; conservative PF>1.10 and expectancy>0, relative MTM DD<=6%, nonnegative worst quarter, no unidentified complete PnL. A candidate passing discovery alone is not approved.
future_test_protocol.replication: At least two nonoverlapping prelocked long periods, including a genuinely untouched prospective period. Any prior-year retrospective sample after discovery is external-time evaluation, not automatically a blind holdout. Freeze all revisions and account for multiple hypotheses.
future_test_protocol.current_data_split: 2025-2026 repeatedly exposed IN_SAMPLE; 104 old boundary bars insufficient; NO_FRESH_HOLDOUT
future_test_protocol.new_data_permission: No connection/download now. A regular prior-year M15 collection requires separate explicit scope/time/size approval.
